standard.summary: 训练辅助工具：copilot 在训练过程中提供实时建议（如 LR 调整建议、过拟合预警）；goal_forecast 预测达到目标 loss 所需的额外步数；ui_custom_params 允许传递自定义 UI 参数。
standard.effect: copilot_tool 开启后，训练日志中会包含训练健康状态的诊断建议（基于当前 loss 趋势和梯度统计）。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性功能，适合希望获得训练过程智能建议的场景。
standard.avoidWhen: 这些工具增加监控开销，追求纯粹训练速度时关闭。

standard_en.summary: Training assistance tools: copilot offers live suggestions during the run (LR adjustments, overfitting warnings); goal_forecast predicts how many more steps a target loss needs; ui_custom_params lets custom UI parameters through.
standard_en.effect: With copilot_tool on, the training log carries diagnostic advice on the health of the run, based on the current loss trend and gradient statistics.
standard_en.whenToUse: An experimental feature for anyone who wants intelligent suggestions as the run proceeds.
standard_en.avoidWhen: These tools add monitoring overhead; turn them off when chasing raw training speed.

advanced.principle: 一次授权无人值守：设定目标阈值（loss / 验证 loss / L2）+ 预算护栏 + 超参搜索空间，Copilot 自动发射训练试验、用只读预测器评估趋势、爬山调参（带回退护栏：变差则回滚到历史最优再换方向），直到达标即停或预算触顶兜底停。每个试验走既有训练队列通道，不新增训练入口。

advanced_en.principle: One-authorization unattended operation: set a target threshold (loss / validation loss / L2) + budget guardrails + a hyperparameter search space, and Copilot automatically launches training trials, evaluates trends with the read-only predictor, and hill-climbs parameters (with a rollback guardrail: on regression, roll back to the historical best and switch direction) until the goal is met or the budget cap stops it as a fallback. Every trial goes through the existing training-queue channel; no new training entry point is added.
